summary: Evaxion A/S, a Danish clinical-stage immunotherapy company, furnished a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US Form 8-K/current report) covering its second-quarter 2026 results for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements and management's discussion and analysis, plus inline XBRL exhibits, and incorporates Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2 by reference into existing Form S-8, F-3 and F-1 registration statements. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor or structural terms are stated; this is a routine periodic earnings report rather than a special situation, with no deal-related risk-arb angle.
